palais-bravo.desc: Palace-hotel with pool, garden and restaurant, in the former home of the painter Claudio Bravo.

dar-al-hossoun.desc: Luxury hotel among olive groves outside the walls, with two pools, hammams and a spa.

dar-salam-souss.desc: Whitewashed riad on the north-western edge of the medina, with a tiled pool, hammam and spa.

dar-zahia.desc: Budget-friendly guesthouse in the heart of the medina, with a green courtyard and rooftop breakfast.

riad-amnay.desc: Traditional riad in the middle of the medina, around an open courtyard, with home-cooked meals.

dar-les-dattiers.desc: Quiet guesthouse by the ochre walls, south of the medina, with a courtyard, pool and shared kitchen.

riad-jardin-des-orangers.desc: Five-room riad in an adobe village among orange and olive trees, with a pool; best with a car.

riad-tania-mozaik.desc: Peaceful riad with a palm courtyard, pool and hammam, about 10 minutes from the medina.

riad-anma.desc: Budget riad east of town with a pool and jacuzzi, about 20 minutes from the medina; a car is advised.

dar-zitoune.desc: Eco-minded hotel with bungalows, suites and tents in large gardens on the southern edge, with a heated pool.

hotel-riad-taroudant.desc: Riad-style hotel in the Derb Jdid quarter of the medina.
